'''Milton Edward Doyle''' (born October 31, 1993) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Illawarra Hawks]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Loyola Ramblers men's basketball|Loyola Ramblers]].

==High school career==
Doyle attended [[Marshall Metropolitan High School|Marshall High School]] in [[Chicago, Illinois]]. As a senior, he averaged 19 points, seven rebounds, five assists and five steals per game.<ref name=loyolaramblers>{{cite web |title=Milton Doyle - Men's Basketball |url=https://loyolaramblers.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/milton-doyle/29 |website=Loyola University Chicago Athletics |access-date=3 October 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

Doyle wasn't a highly rated recruit, in part because a wrist injury kept of him off of the AAU circuit in the summer of 2011.<ref name=cjonline>{{cite news |last1=Meek |first1=Austin |title=Freshman Doyle leaves KU hoops team |url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/college/2012/08/20/freshman-doyle-leaves-ku-hoops-team/16423884007/ |access-date=3 October 2025 |work=The Topeka Capital-Journal |date=20 August 2012}}</ref>

==College career==
Doyle signed a financial aid agreement with the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas Jayhawks]]. He was a late addition to KU's recruiting class after originally committing to [[FIU Panthers men's basketball|Florida International]]. After enrolling at KU in June 2012, he participated in offseason workouts with the Jayhawks, including the team's trip to France and Switzerland in August 2012. Upon returning to the U.S., Doyle left the program after KU granted his scholarship release.<ref name="cjonline" />

Doyle transferred to the [[Loyola Ramblers men's basketball|Loyola Ramblers]], but had to sit out the 2012–13 season due to NCAA transfer regulations.<ref name="loyolaramblers" /> He debuted for the Ramblers in the 2013–14 season.<ref name="loyolaramblers" />

In the [[2016–17 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|2016–17 season]], Doyle became the first player in Ramblers' history to be named to the All-[[Missouri Valley Conference|MVC]] First Team<ref>{{cite web|title=Milton Doyle – 2017–18 Men's Basketball Roster – Loyola University Chicago|url=http://loyolaramblers.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=16|website=loyolaramblers.com|access-date=7 August 2017|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180204010220/http://loyolaramblers.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=16|archive-date=4 February 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref> and earned NABC First Team All-District 16 honours.<ref>{{cite web|title=Milton Doyle Named NABC First Team All-District 16|url=http://www.loyolaramblers.com/news/2017/3/22/Milton_Doyle_Named_NABC_First_Team_All_District_16.aspx?path=mbball|website=loyolaramblers.com|access-date=7 August 2017}}</ref> He was also named MVC player of the week twice during the 2016–17 season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Milton Doyle Named MVC Player Of The Week – Loyola University Chicago|url=http://www.loyolaramblers.com/news/2017/1/9/Milton_Doyle_Named_MVC_Player_Of_The_Week.aspx|website=www.loyolaramblers.com|access-date=7 August 2017|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Milton Doyle Named MVC Player Of The Week|url=http://www.loyolaramblers.com/news/2017/1/30/Milton_Doyle_Named_MVC_Player_Of_The_Week.aspx?path=mbball|website=loyolaramblers.com|access-date=7 August 2017}}</ref>

==Professional career==

=== Long Island Nets (2017) ===
Doyle went undrafted for the [[2017 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Undrafted Free Agent Tracker • r/nba|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/nba/comments/6j351n/undrafted_free_agent_tracker/|website=reddit.com|date=23 June 2017 |access-date=7 August 2017|language=en}}</ref> On June 23, 2017, Doyle was invited to join the [[Brooklyn Nets]]' [[2017 NBA Summer League]] team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Doyle Earns NBA Summer League Invite|url=http://arenasportsnet.com/doyle-earns-nba-summer-league-invite/|website=arenasportsnet.com|access-date=7 August 2017|date=24 June 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170808001339/http://arenasportsnet.com/doyle-earns-nba-summer-league-invite/|archive-date=8 August 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> He scored 13 points, 4 rebounds and 1 assist in 16 minutes of play in his debut.<ref>{{cite web|title=Doyle Dazzles In NBA Summer League Debut – Loyola University Chicago|url=http://loyolaramblers.com/news/2017/7/9/mens-basketball-doyle-dazzles-in-nba-summer-league-debut.aspx|website=loyolaramblers.com|access-date=7 August 2017|language=en}}</ref>

On August 4, 2017, Doyle signed with the Nets.<ref>{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets Sign Milton Doyle and Jeremy Senglin|url=http://www.nba.com/nets/news/2017/08/04/sign-milton-doyle-jeremy-senglin/|website=nba.com|access-date=7 August 2017}}</ref> On October 11, he was waived by the Nets.<ref>{{cite news|title=Brooklyn Nets waive three players|url=http://www.nba.com/nets/news/2017/10/11/brooklyn-nets-waive-three-players |access-date=October 12, 2017|work=[[Brooklyn Nets]]|date=October 11, 2017}}</ref> He would later be assigned to the [[Long Island Nets]] [[NBA G League]] affiliate squad after being waived, playing for them in 17 games around that time.

=== Brooklyn Nets (2017–2018) ===
On December 18, the [[Brooklyn Nets]] signed Doyle to a [[two-way contract]] after waiving their previous candidate [[Yakuba Ouattara]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets Sign Milton Doyle To Two-Way Contract|url=http://www.nba.com/nets/news/2017/12/18/nets-sign-milton-doyle-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|access-date=December 18, 2017|date=December 18, 2017}}</ref> From this point throughout the rest of the season onward, Doyle would split playing time between the parent squad in Brooklyn and the affiliate squad in Long Island, with a majority of his time spent on Long Island. Doyle would make his NBA debut on December 26, 2017, scoring 2 points in a single minute of action under a 109–97 loss against the [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore?gameId=400975248|title=Nets vs. Spurs – Box Score|work=ESPN.com|date=December 26, 2017|access-date=April 28, 2018}}</ref>

=== Murcia (2018–2019) ===
On August 8, 2018, Doyle signed a one-year deal with [[CB Murcia|UCAM Murcia]] of the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{cite news |title=ACB.COM – Milton Doyle, un cañonero para UCAM Murcia |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=142505 |access-date=8 August 2018 |work=www.acb.com |date=8 August 2018 |language=es-ES}}</ref>

=== Windy City Bulls (2019–2020) ===
On September 30, 2019, Doyle signed a partially guaranteed deal with the [[Chicago Bulls]].<ref name="bullstraining">{{cite web|title=Bulls Finalize 2019–20 Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-finalize-2019-20-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|access-date=September 30, 2019|date=September 30, 2019}}</ref> He was assigned to their G League affiliate, the [[Windy City Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kessenich |first1=Joe |title=WINDY CITY BULLS ANNOUNCE 2019–20 OPENING NIGHT ROSTER FOR TEAM'S FOURTH SEASON |url=https://windycity.gleague.nba.com/news/windy-city-bulls-announce-2019-20-opening-night-roster-for-teams-fourth-season/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=December 5, 2019 |date=November 7, 2019}}</ref> During the shortened 2019–20 season, Doyle averaged 17.5 points, 5.8 assists, 4.1 rebounds, and 2 steals per game, shooting 40% from the field and 36% from three point range.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Schmidt |first1=Dakota |title=Let's Appreciate Some G Leaguers: Edition #5 |url=https://www.ridiculousupside.com/2020/4/25/21236557/lets-appreciate-some-g-leaguers-marial-shayok-brandon-fields-milton-doyle |website=Ridiculous Upside |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |access-date=May 3, 2020 |date=April 25, 2020}}</ref>

===Pallacanestro Trieste (2020–2021)===
In July 2020, Doyle signed with Italian team [[Pallacanestro Trieste]].<ref>{{cite web |title=La ciliegina sulla torta: Milton Doyle firma con l'Allianz Pallacanestro Trieste |url=http://www.pallacanestrotrieste.it/news/265597390342/la-ciliegina-sulla-torta-milton-doyle-firma-con-l-039-allianz-pallacanestro-trieste |publisher=pallacanestrotrieste.it |date=31 July 2020 |language=it }}</ref>

=== Gaziantep Basketbol (2021–2022) ===
On August 12, 2021, Doyle signed with [[Gaziantep Basketbol]] of the [[Basketball Super League|Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://gaziantepbasketbol.com.tr/milton-doyle-gaziantep-basketbolda/|title=Milton Doyle Gaziantep Basketbol'da|last=|first=|date=August 12, 2021|website=gaziantepbasketbol.com.tr|publisher=|language=tr|access-date=August 12, 2021}}</ref>

===Tasmania JackJumpers, Tofaş and Indios de Mayagüez (2022–2025)===
On June 24, 2022, Doyle signed with the [[Tasmania JackJumpers]] in Australia for the [[2022–23 NBL season]].<ref>{{cite web |title=JackJumpers Sign Milton Doyle |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/jackjumpers-sign-milton-doyle |work=NBL.com.au |date=June 24, 2022 |access-date=June 24, 2022}}</ref> He was named to the [[All-NBL Team|All-NBL First Team]] and earned Club MVP honors, averaging 17 points, 5 rebounds, and 3.7 assists per game.<ref name=jackjumpers25>{{cite web |title=25til25: Milton Doyle inks 2-year deal |url=https://www.jackjumpers.com.au/news/25til25-milton-doyle-inks-2-year-deal |work=jackjumpers.com.au |date=June 8, 2023 |access-date=June 8, 2023}}</ref>

On February 21, 2023, Doyle signed with [[Tofaş S.K.|Tofaş]] of [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.basketfaul.com/haber?haber=106516|title=Eski Gaziantepli TOFAŞ'ta|last=|first=|date=February 21, 2023|website=|publisher=basketfaul|language=tr|access-date=February 21, 2023}}</ref>

On June 8, 2023, Doyle re-signed with the JackJumpers on a two-year deal.<ref name="jackjumpers25" /> In the [[2023–24 NBL season]], the JackJumpers reached the NBL Grand Final series,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://nbl.com.au/news/jackjumpers-dominant-in-playoff-decider|title=JackJumpers dominant in Playoff decider|work=NBL.com.au|date=13 March 2024|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240313134844/https://nbl.com.au/news/jackjumpers-dominant-in-playoff-decider|archive-date=13 March 2024}}</ref> where they won the [[List of NBL champions|NBL championship]] with a 3–2 grand final series victory over [[Melbourne United]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://nbl.com.au/news/tasmania-jackjumpers-nbl24-champions|title=Tasmania JackJumpers: NBL24 Champions|work=NBL.com.au|date=31 March 2024|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240331074750/https://nbl.com.au/news/tasmania-jackjumpers-nbl24-champions|archive-date=31 March 2024}}</ref>

On April 8, 2024, Doyle signed with [[Indios de Mayagüez (basketball)|Indios de Mayagüez]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]] for the [[2024 Baloncesto Superior Nacional season|2024 season]].<ref>{{cite tweet|author=La Guerra del BSN|title=#BSNPR OFICIAL: MILTON DOYLE A LA TRIBU El escolta Milton Doyle es el nuevo refuerzo de los Indios de Mayagüez para la temporada 2024 del Baloncesto Superior Nacional. Doyle tiene 30 años, mide 6'4 y viene de promediar 15.5 PPG, 4.6 RPG y 5 APG en 31 MPG durante 29 partidos con el club Tasmania Jackjumpers en la NBL de Australia donde quedó campeón El escolta cuenta con experiencia en la G-League, España (ACB), Italia, Israel, Turquía y Australia.|number=1777385744933261815|user=LaGuerraBSN|date=April 8, 2024|access-date=April 8, 2024|language=Spanish}}</ref>

On November 15, 2024, Doyle scored 32 points with eight 3-pointers in the JackJumpers' 95–92 win over the [[Brisbane Bullets]].<ref>{{cite news |title=JackJumpers win thriller on hot Doyle |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/jackjumpers-win-thriller-on-hot-doyle |access-date=15 November 2024 |work=NBL Official Website |date=15 November 2024}}</ref>

Doyle re-joined Indios de Mayagüez for the [[2025 Baloncesto Superior Nacional season|2025 BSN season]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Modestti |first1=Luis |title=Mayagüez announces their import trio for 2025 |url=https://www.latinbasket.com/Puerto-Rico/news/911067/Mayag%C3%BCez-announces-their-import-trio-for-2025 |access-date=11 March 2025 |work=latinbasket.com |date=8 January 2025}}</ref>

===Melbourne United and Napoli (2025–2026)===
On June 13, 2025, Doyle signed with [[Melbourne United]] for the [[2025–26 NBL season]].<ref>{{cite news |title=United reload: Doyle first import domino in title chase |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/united-reload-doyle-first-import-domino-in-title-chase |access-date=13 June 2025 |work=nbl.com.au |date=13 June 2025 |language=en}}</ref> He averaged 16.2 points, 3.6 rebounds and 4.3 assists per game.<ref name=italysigning/>

On March 13, 2026, Doyle signed with [[Napoli Basket (2016)|Napoli]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]].<ref name=italysigning>{{cite web |title=Doyle signs with Napoli for final stretch of Serie A season |url=https://www.melbourneutd.com.au/news/doyle-signs-with-napoli-for-final-stretch-of-serie-a-season |website=Melbourne United |access-date=August 1, 2026 |date=March 13, 2026}}</ref>

===Illawarra Hawks (2026–present)===
On July 30, 2026, Doyle signed with the [[Illawarra Hawks]] for the [[2026–27 NBL season]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Hawks Land Championship Guard Milton Doyle {{!}} Illawarra Hawks |url=https://www.hawks.com.au/news/hawks-land-championship-guard-milton-doyle |access-date=30 July 2026 |work=www.hawks.com.au |date=30 July 2026 |language=en}}</ref>
